_**Agent (grok-4.5)**_

Move the post into `_drafts/` instead of `_posts/`.

This site already uses that pattern (e.g. `_drafts/2023-12-25-dynamic-decoding.md`). Jekyll skips `_drafts/` on a normal build/deploy, so the post won’t go live.

**To draft an existing post**

1. Move it from `_posts/` → `_drafts/`
2. You can keep or drop the date prefix; drafts don’t need a publish date until you ship them

Example for your CTMC post:

```bash
mv _posts/2026-05-10-ctmc.md _drafts/2026-05-10-ctmc.md
```

**To preview drafts locally**

```bash
bundle exec jekyll serve --drafts
```

**To publish later**

Move the file back to `_posts/` with a `YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md` name (and set `date` in the front matter if you use it).
